snippet.title: Developing A Roguelite Stationbuilding Survival Game - In Space
snippet.description:
Project Mercury is an indie sci-fi survival base building game about keeping the last fleet of humanity alive. You’ll jump from star system to star system, building temporary stations to harvest just enough energy for the next jump, all while a relentless swarm of energy hungry machines closes in.

Each mission is a race against time. Balance your energy economy, keep your crews sane, and hold your station together long enough to escape.

This is the first introduction to Project Mercury. Follow along for behind-the-scenes updates, early gameplay videos, and playtesting opportunities.

Good jump, Commander.

📬 Sign up for the newsletter to get progress updates and early access: https://tinyurl.com/msckjs2h
